Record Class ReportSummaryModels.SummaryView

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.ReportSummaryModels.SummaryView
Record Components:
schemaVersion - response schema
empty - whether no Allure results were found to reconcile
emptyMessage - empty-state guidance (includes generate_test_report CTA when empty)
allureResultsPath - resolved results directory inspected (may be blank)
reportPath - resolved Allure HTML path when present (may be blank)
counts - reconciled status totals (no secrets)
flakeRetryHiddenCount - rows tagged retry-hidden
flakeTransitionsCount - rows tagged transitions
healRecoveredCount - RECOVERED heal reports
healAmbiguousCount - AMBIGUOUS heal reports
healNoCandidatesCount - NO_CANDIDATES heal reports
engineerSummary - playbook-shaped engineer text
stakeholderSummary - playbook-shaped stakeholder text
warnings - non-fatal notes
Enclosing class:
ReportSummaryModels
